newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against the U.S. dollar and sterling but closed Monday's interbank session firmer against the mark and the rand.
"There was a corporate payment of about U.S.$1 million and people were buying to cover for that. The central bank didn't intervene," one dealer said.
"This also co-incided with lack of tobacco inflows today so there was nothing to stabilise the Zimbabwe dollar," he added.
The local unit finished the day at 11.3050/3150 against the U.S. dollar, dropping from Friday's 11.2900/3000 and was at 18.3400/3600 from 18.3210/3490 versus sterling.
It however firmed on the rand to 2.5300/5500 from 2.5350/5390 and was at 6.5300/5500 versus the mark, up from 6.5770/5850.
